domain-information: A Procurement Manager requests a price quote from an overseas supplier to compare options for a new product line
A Procurement Manager reviews a supplier’s compliance documents to ensure the goods meet local import rules
A Supplier sends a proforma invoice to confirm the product cost and shipping terms
A Supplier adjusts the shipment schedule after receiving the buyer’s updated delivery expectations
A Logistics Coordinator books international freight with a carrier to secure space on an upcoming vessel
A Logistics Coordinator tracks the carrier’s progress to update the buyer on expected arrival time
A Customs Specialist prepares a customs declaration to make sure the goods can legally enter the country
A Customs Specialist checks the product classification codes to avoid delays during the border inspection
A Warehouse Receiver inspects the delivered goods to verify that quantities match the import documents
A Warehouse Receiver logs the received shipment into inventory so the order can be released to the buyer

domain objects.name: Procurement Manager
domain objects.description: role that handles buying activities and contacts suppliers

domain objects.name: Price Quote Request
domain objects.description: request sent to a supplier asking for pricing and terms

domain objects.name: Supplier
domain objects.description: party that sells goods and provides documents

domain objects.name: Compliance Document
domain objects.description: papers proving the goods meet import and safety rules

domain objects.name: Local Import Rules
domain objects.description: regulations the goods must follow in the destination country

domain objects.name: Proforma Invoice
domain objects.description: initial invoice showing product cost and shipping terms

domain objects.name: Product Cost
domain objects.description: price charged for the goods

domain objects.name: Shipping Terms
domain objects.description: conditions that define who pays and handles transport

domain objects.name: Shipment Schedule
domain objects.description: supplier’s planned timeline for sending the goods

domain objects.name: Delivery Expectation
domain objects.description: buyer’s desired arrival time for the goods

domain objects.name: Buyer
domain objects.description: organization receiving and paying for the goods

domain objects.name: Logistics Coordinator
domain objects.description: role that arranges transport and tracks freight

domain objects.name: International Freight Booking
domain objects.description: reservation for cargo transport with a carrier

domain objects.name: Carrier
domain objects.description: company that physically transports the shipment

domain objects.name: Arrival Update
domain objects.description: status info about when the shipment is expected to arrive

domain objects.name: Customs Specialist
domain objects.description: role that handles the paperwork for clearing goods at the border

domain objects.name: Code Check
domain objects.description: verification of product classification codes for customs

domain objects.name: Warehouse Receiver
domain objects.description: role that inspects and logs goods when they arrive

domain objects.name: Inventory
domain objects.description: stock records that show what goods are available

domain objects.name: Shipment
domain objects.description: set of goods transported together

domain objects.name: Customs Declaration
domain objects.description: document submitted to customs describing the goods
